title: Local tensor and pullback normalization for intrinsic etale origins
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings, φ:A→B a unital homomorphism, p:Z→Y any scheme morphism, and C any object of D(Y_et,A), with no lower bound. Use F_T, the intrinsic coefficient comparison, and q_C=properOriginTensorIso from [def-fix-proper-etale-origin-scalar-data]. Let L_e,L_A be the etale and intrinsic pro-etale geometric pullbacks. Let a:F_Y L_A→L_e F_Z be originPullback, the inverse mate of the ambient fixed site counit mate conjugated by the specified realization/direct-image comparisons; its bounded-below right mate is properOriginMateIso. Write S_T=U_T S^B_T for intrinsic scalar extension followed by restriction. Let s:S_Y L_A→L_A S_Z be originScalarPullback: restriction/pullback comparison followed by the scalar-extension pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. Let t:((- tensor B_Y) L_e)→L_e(- tensor B_Z) be originEtaleTensorPullback, the canonical tensor/pullback comparison followed by the constant-coefficient pullback identification [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Then L_A(q_C);s_(F_Y C);S_Z(a_C) = a_(C tensor B_Y);F_Z(t_C);q_(L_e C). This is the local left-adjoint normalization square, before taking right mates or evaluating on a right-derived direct image.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleOriginScalarPullbackSquare
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ Y)
    (C : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) Y) :
    (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A p).map (properOriginTensorIso φ Y C).hom ≫
      (originScalarPullback φ p).app
        ((finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Y A).obj C) ≫
      (directImageScalarExtension φ Z ⋙ (scalarMateRestriction φ Z).mapDerivedCategory).map
        ((originPullback A p).app C) =
    (originPullback A p).app
        (properOriginEtaleTensor (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) Y C) ≫
      (finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Z A).map
        ((originEtaleTensorPullback (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) p).app C) ≫
      (properOriginTensorIso φ Z
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) p).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
          C)).hom
